result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban intersection with high pedestrian exposure due to long crossing distances. While marked crosswalks and traffic signals are present, the lack of physical refuge islands and the presence of wide turning radii create a high-speed environment for vehicles.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main intersection

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing the risk of collisions with pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the white crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised islands in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.
